Serve as the go-to expert for day-to-day Vantagepoint system issues, user support, and enhancement requests. Document and maintain a comprehensive library of system configurations, integration architecture maps, and standard operating procedures. Document outcomes and, where applicable, transition any new processes or configurations into standard operating procedures. Advanced SQL skills and experience building custom reports within or alongside Vantagepoint. Working knowledge of Chart of Accounts design, project numbering standards, and data mapping for multi-entity consolidation. Experience managing system security, user roles, and workflow configuration within the Deltek ERP environment. Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent, high-priority technical initiatives. Demonstrated track record of identifying inefficient processes and driving measurable efficiency gains within an ERP or similar system environment. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical system requirements for Finance, Payroll, and HR stakeholders. Comfortable taking on occasional large-scale, one-time system initiatives (e.g., a fiscal year-end conversion) as they arise under the Special Projects portion of the role. PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year. Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents. review_candidates.description: Senior Associate (Partnerships Manager) — Global Supply Partnership You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform. Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world-class supply partnerships fueling the machine. That's where you come in. The Role — In Plain English You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets. This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week. Your week might look like this: Monday: Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates. Tuesday: Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides. Wednesday: Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high-value partner launch. Thursday: Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week. Friday: Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy-in. Start executing. You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role. What Makes This Different Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two. You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams. Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done. You Might Be Right For This If... You have 2+ years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client-facing roles — ideally in SaaS, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number. You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed You can context-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to. You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you What You'll Get Real ownership: Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one Leadership exposure: Work directly with CXOs and cross-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success Growth trajectory: Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem Compensation: Among the most competitive in India, including stock options Global scope: Partners and markets that span continents — not a single-geography desk job If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk. Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.
